cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Industrial Engineer to join our team. This role will provide Industrial Engineering services and partner with manufacturing operations, logistics, and IT to ensure continuous process improvements related to safety, quality, productivity, and manufacturing costs. The role supports plant operations through the design, development, testing, and evaluation of basic integrated systems for managing product distribution systems and print-on-demand processes including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Participates in cross-functional teams to deliver and coordinate multiple projects including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications and other analyses.
Participates in the design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings.
Executes new programs/projects that enhance performance or increases capabilities for the business.
Contributes to the planning and development of engineering strategy and provides technical advice.
Executes lean project initiatives including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and establishing and managing the project schedule.
Travels to various sites to lead the installation of new systems.
Travels to various vendors as needed to evaluate new applications of technology.
Communicates study results and makes recommendations to management.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical degree
2 Years in a manufacturing or distribution environment
2 Years experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs or process improvements
2 Years experience in AutoCAD computer software
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering
Experience with SolidWorks
2–5 Years experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment
Strong communication skills and the ability to build cross-departmental partnerships

They will support plant operations through the design, development, testing, and evaluation of basic integrated systems for managing product distribution systems & print-on-demand processes including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination.
cond_0138.responsibilities:
Participates in cross-functional teams to deliver and coordinate multiple projects including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications and other analyses.
Participates in the design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings.
Executes new programs/projects that enhance performance or increases capabilities for the business.
Contributes to the planning and development of engineering strategy and provides technical advice.
Executes lean project initiatives including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and establishing and managing the project schedule.
Travels to various sites to lead the installation of new systems. (Role requires the ability to travel up to 25% of the time)
Travels to various vendors as needed to evaluate new applications of technology.
Communicates study results and makes recommendations to management.
cond_0138.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 2 years of experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around 2 years of experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs, or process improvements.
Around 2 years of experience working with AutoCAD computer software.
Experience with SolidWorks, or willingness to build that familiarity.
2–5 Years of experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Ability to communicate effectively and build working relationships across departments.

This role supports plant operations through the design, development, testing, and evaluation of integrated systems for managing product distribution systems and print-on-demand processes, including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination.
cond_0180.responsibilities:
Participates in cross-functional teams to coordinate and deliver multiple projects including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications, and other analyses.
Collaborates on design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings.
Works with the team to execute new programs and projects that enhance performance or increase capabilities for the business.
Contributes to the planning and development of engineering strategy and shares technical advice with stakeholders.
Coordinates lean project initiatives including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and managing the project schedule.
Travels to various sites to support the installation of new systems in coordination with site teams. (Role requires the ability to travel up to 25% of the time)
Travels to various vendors as needed to jointly evaluate new applications of technology.
Shares study results and makes recommendations to management.
cond_0180.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical degree.
2 Years in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
2 Years experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs, or process improvements.
2 Years experience in AutoCAD computer software.
Bachelor's Degree in Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
Experience with SolidWorks.
2–5 Years experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build cross-departmental partnerships.
cond_0180.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

You will regularly support plant operations through the design, development, testing, and evaluation of integrated systems for managing product distribution and print-on-demand processes — including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination.
cond_0213.responsibilities:
Actively participate in cross-functional teams to deliver and coordinate multiple projects, including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications, and other analyses.
Contribute to design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings — regularly communicating progress and trade-offs with team members.
Execute new programs and projects that enhance performance or increase capabilities for the business.
Contribute to the planning and development of engineering strategy and provide technical advice to stakeholders across departments.
Execute lean project initiatives, including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and establishing and managing the project schedule.
Travel to various sites to lead the installation of new systems, working directly with on-site teams throughout the process. (Role requires the ability to travel up to 25% of the time.)
Travel to various vendors as needed to evaluate new applications of technology.
Communicate study results clearly and make recommendations to management, walking them through findings and handling questions.
cond_0213.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical degree.
2 Years of experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
2 Years of experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs, or process improvements.
2 Years of experience with AutoCAD computer software.
Bachelor's Degree in Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering.
Experience with SolidWorks.
2–5 Years of experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build cross-departmental partnerships.
cond_0213.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

cond_0307.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Industrial Engineer to join our team. This role will provide Industrial Engineering services and partner with manufacturing operations, logistics, and IT to ensure continuous process improvements related to safety, quality, productivity, and manufacturing costs. The role supports plant operations through the design, development, testing, and evaluation of basic integrated systems for managing product distribution systems and print-on-demand processes including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination.
cond_0307.responsibilities:
Participates in cross-functional teams to deliver and coordinate multiple projects including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications and other analyses.
Participates in the design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings.
Executes new programs/projects that enhance performance or increases capabilities for the business.
Contributes to the planning and development of engineering strategy and provides technical advice.
Executes lean project initiatives including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and establishing and managing the project schedule.
Travels to various sites to lead the installation of new systems.
Travels to various vendors as needed to evaluate new applications of technology.
Communicates study results and makes recommendations to management.
cond_0307.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical degree
2 Years in a manufacturing or distribution environment
2 Years experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs or process improvements
2 Years experience in AutoCAD computer software
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering
Experience with SolidWorks
2–5 Years experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment
Strong communication skills and the ability to build cross-departmental partnerships

This role supports plant operations through coordinating the design, development, testing, and evaluation of integrated systems for managing product distribution systems and print-on-demand processes, including productivity measurement, human work factors, inventory control, logistics, material flow, cost analysis, and production coordination.
cond_0441.responsibilities:
Participate in cross-functional teams to coordinate and deliver multiple projects, including basic feasibility studies, multi-option production expansion analysis, capital project justifications, and other analyses.
Collaborate on design efforts for new and revised products, processes, systems, and technologies that drive efficiencies and cost savings.
Work with the team to execute new programs and projects that enhance performance or increase capabilities for the business.
Contribute to the planning and development of engineering strategy and share technical advice with relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate lean project initiatives, including defining scope, design criteria, budgets, resource needs, and helping establish and manage the project schedule.
Travel to various sites to support the installation of new systems in coordination with local teams. (Role requires the ability to travel up to 25% of the time)
Travel to various vendors as needed to jointly evaluate new applications of technology.
Share study results and work with management to develop recommendations.
cond_0441.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical degree
2 Years of experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment
2 Years of experience with new layouts, material handling, PLCs, or process improvements
2 Years of experience with AutoCAD
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering
Experience with SolidWorks
2–5 Years of experience in an engineering role in a manufacturing or distribution environment
Strong communication skills and the ability to build cross-departmental partnerships
